title: Fort Worth Officers Shoot Man Charging at Them with Knives
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Fort Worth, Texas — On January 15, 2025, at approximately 4:22 a.m., Northwest Division officers were called to a domestic disturbance at home in the 5800 block of Westgate Dr. The 911 caller opened one of the front doors to the house to speak to officers and was attempting to open a second metal screen door but was having difficulty getting it to open. Simultaneously, officers observed the suspect, Brandon Adame, 28, of Fort Worth, inside the house and armed with a knife. Arriving officers went to the backyard to seek an alternate entry point, while one officer stayed up front continuing dialogue with Adame and his mother. 

Due to active threats from Adame to the victim, and the fear of anyone being harmed within the household, officers attempted to force their way in by kicking in the back door. At that time, the back door was breached and Adame exited the back door, charging at the officers with two knives, one in each hand. Two officers then fired their service weapons in his direction, striking him and he fell to the ground. After several commands to drop the knives, officers provided medical attention. Adame was pronounced deceased on the scene. No officers or other civilians were injured during this incident.
